payload.posture: Read Luke 4:5–8 as one movement in the temptation of Jesus, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states the devil shows the kingdoms in a moment of time, claims authority over them, offers it to Jesus, and receives an answer about worship and service owed to God. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the temptation of Jesus.
